dedupeText: rustic new wave album cover sepia slab serif octagon emblem textured paper 80s fashion industrial interior the octagon emblem overlaps the top left corner of the central image frame the horizontal blue and red striped borders create a distinct separation between the tan header footer and the central photo the warm desaturated tones of the photograph harmonize with the tan fibrous texture of the outer frame combine a textured scrapbook frame with a central low key photograph anchored by a geometric emblem and wide tracked typewriter typography

recipe.visualDefinition: A multi-layered composition featuring a central rectangular photograph of three men in an industrial, earthy setting, framed by a textured tan border with a geometric emblem in the upper left and typewriter-style typography.
coreVisualRelationships: The octagon emblem overlaps the top-left corner of the central image frame.
The horizontal blue-and-red striped borders create a distinct separation between the tan header/footer and the central photo.
The warm, desaturated tones of the photograph harmonize with the tan, fibrous texture of the outer frame.
coreInvariants: Tan parchment-like texture for the outer frame
Octagonal badge with internal horizontal pinstripes
Blue and red diagonal striped divider lines

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The central photograph occupies the middle 60% of the vertical space, featuring three figures at medium-full scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The octagonal emblem in the top-left corner acts as the primary brand anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top-left emblem, move right across the title text, then drop into the central photograph's subjects.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space in the tan border areas provides a 'scrapbook' or 'archival' feel.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Dark Brown/Black (shadows in photo and typography)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Powder Blue and Salmon Pink (emblem and striped borders)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast in the central photo's lighting.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Monospaced slab serif and high-contrast serif
letterConstructionRules: Title text uses wide tracking and uniform stroke weight
Emblem text uses a condensed, high-contrast serif for the large initial
Secondary emblem text uses a typewriter-style slab serif
characterSpecificRedesigns: Large initial 'Z' features extremely thin horizontal bars and thick vertical strokes
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A monospaced typewriter font for the title paired with a high-contrast modern serif for the logo mark.
graphicDevices: Octagonal border with dashed line detail
Horizontal pinstripe background within the emblem

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the mechanical, slab-serif look of the title text.
Matches the high-contrast verticality of the large emblem initial.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an image of three men in 1980s attire (oversized shirts, high-waisted trousers) posing in a dark, rustic cellar with stone walls. Frame this image with a thick tan paper-textured border. Add blue and red diagonal striped lines above and below the photo.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place an octagonal badge in the top left with pink pinstripes and a large high-contrast serif letter. To the right, type the album title in an uppercase monospaced slab-serif font with wide tracking.

verificationChecks: Check that the octagon overlaps the photo frame.
Ensure the tan texture looks like heavy cardstock.
Verify the striped dividers have a 45-degree tilt.
Confirm the title text is dark brown, not pure black.

adjustableVariables: Color of the pinstripes in the emblem
Number of figures in the central photo
postGenerationChecks: Is the octagon centered vertically within the top tan section?
Does the central photo have a soft, film-like grain?
Are the slab serifs distinct and legible?
Is the overall layout symmetrical along the vertical axis?
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a textured 'scrapbook' frame with a central low-key photograph, anchored by a geometric emblem and wide-tracked typewriter typography.
